typicalDayNote: Typical-day hourly averages pooled across the displayed period · Europe/Berlin. This is not a specific day or live data.
approximateHourly: Means are approximate because this export contains rounded service-type averages.
pulseHint: Hover for the hour range and delay. Grey line: weighted mean for the map selection. Click or drag to choose an hour; arrow keys also work.
clockInteract: Choose an hour here or in the line chart to update all three views.
